pairs.frequent_confusion: Duplicate HTML IDs are not alone a 4.1.1 failure in current 2.1 HTML/XML recommendation
pairs.resolution: Classify real harm to relationships or names under 1.3.1 or 4.1.2; still fix invalid HTML as engineering quality
pairs.discriminator_test: Can user or AT perceive an actual incorrect label, role or relationship?

pairs.frequent_confusion: Transcript is generally useful but not a replacement for prerecorded synchronized captions or AA audio description
pairs.resolution: Identify media type, presence of synchronized speech/video and visual-only information before selecting equivalent
pairs.discriminator_test: Is the user trying to perceive speech, sound effects or visual action at the time of playback?

pairs.frequent_confusion: Level A permits described audio OR full media alternative but Level AA requires audio description
pairs.resolution: At AA implement 1.2.5 regardless of chosen A option
pairs.discriminator_test: Is the stated target A, AA or AAA?

pairs.frequent_confusion: Different text and non-text contrast thresholds and exceptions
pairs.resolution: Classify pixels as ordinary text, large text, necessary UI indicator or essential graphic; measure proper requirement
pairs.discriminator_test: Is a 3:1 contrast token being incorrectly reused for ordinary text?

pairs.frequent_confusion: A contrast fix cannot restore meaning encoded only in red/green
pairs.resolution: Add non-color meaning, then check rendered contrast separately
pairs.discriminator_test: Can meaning be recovered in grayscale without guessing?

pairs.frequent_confusion: 200% resize, 320px-equivalent reflow and text-spacing overrides are distinct checks
pairs.resolution: Test separately; repair flexible sizing, wrapping and overflow across all three states
pairs.discriminator_test: Does the component work under *each* independent user transformation?

pairs.frequent_confusion: A 2D data table exception does not excuse horizontal scrolling for the entire page
pairs.resolution: Scope exception to intrinsically 2D content and keep all surrounding UI reflowed
pairs.discriminator_test: Is two-dimensional layout essential for this specific content part?

pairs.frequent_confusion: WCAG 2.1 AA focus visible does not use newer WCAG 2.2 focus-appearance requirements
pairs.resolution: Provide clear visible focus and evaluate 2.1 normative requirement; stronger design recommendations may still apply
pairs.discriminator_test: Is a newer-version threshold being mislabelled as a 2.1 failure?

pairs.frequent_confusion: A single-pointer gesture alternative may still be impossible to use with keyboard
pairs.resolution: Provide both single-pointer non-path operation and keyboard route where required
pairs.discriminator_test: Can keyboard user and tap-only user finish same goal?

pairs.frequent_confusion: A correct role/name can still differ from visible label, blocking speech input
pairs.resolution: Include visible label words in name; ensure name, role and value all correct
pairs.discriminator_test: Would saying the visible label invoke the control?

pairs.frequent_confusion: Announcing changed content is not the same as moving focus or changing context
pairs.resolution: Preserve focus for routine updates; announce relevant status in live region
pairs.discriminator_test: Did focus, route, window or user context change unexpectedly?

pairs.frequent_confusion: Identifying which field failed is not the same as explaining how to correct it
pairs.resolution: Add specific field and correction suggestions where safe and available
pairs.discriminator_test: Can user identify error AND know how to recover?

pairs.frequent_confusion: AA 3.3.4 is scoped to legal, financial, stored-data and test-response actions; AAA 3.3.6 expands to all user submissions
pairs.resolution: Classify submission scope and level before prescribing confirmation mechanism
pairs.discriminator_test: What data/action is submitted and at which target level?

pairs.frequent_confusion: Unmodified character-key shortcuts have requirements not generally imposed on modifier hotkeys
pairs.resolution: Allow disable, modifier remap or focus scope when user presses unmodified printable keys
pairs.discriminator_test: Does an unmodified character key activate unexpectedly?

pairs.frequent_confusion: A reduced-motion option does not license default content with unsafe flashing
pairs.resolution: Avoid unsafe flash by default, independently honor reduced motion for AAA nonessential interaction animation
pairs.discriminator_test: Can hazardous flash occur under normal settings even if motion option exists?

pairs.frequent_confusion: WCAG 2.1 AAA uses 44x44 CSS px while WCAG 2.2 AA introduces separate 24px rule
pairs.resolution: Audit the exact requested version and level; do not transfer exception calculations
pairs.discriminator_test: Which standard/version and level is authoritative for the claim?

pairs.frequent_confusion: Secure auth expiry does not automatically justify losing work, nor authorize unsafe infinite sessions
pairs.resolution: Use valid timing exception if applicable and preserve draft safely through reauth; inform about data loss at AAA
pairs.discriminator_test: Can users continue after reauth without reviving expired credentials?

pairs.frequent_confusion: Moving focus to announce every async result can harm task flow
pairs.resolution: Use polite live status for nonurgent updates, manage focus only for actual navigation or context transition
pairs.discriminator_test: Did user request navigation, or merely receive status while editing?
